text: Entry Requirements (1)Good physical and mental health (no infectious or contagious diseases and no physical or mental disorders that could interfere with regular study). (2)Applicants should be under 23 by September 1st, 2026 (Birth date must be on or after Sept. 2nd, 2003). (3)Applicants should hold a high school graduation certificate or diploma by September 1st, 2026. (4)Applicants should be competent in performing scientific research and maintain a good academic grade level. The requirement for previous academic grade level is an average score of 75% and above. NPU accepts international standardized tests such as SAT(Score Send Code: 54421)/A-Level/IB or regional high school graduation examination. Applicants should provide the test results of CSCA(China Scholastic Competency Assessment) or Screenshot exam of exam registration (expected test date no later than April 2026), with scores to be supplemented before May 20th, 2026. (5)Language: IELTS Academic Test overall 6.0 or above (no less than 5.5 in each element) TOEFL 80 or above (iBT/iBT Home Edition/MyBest Scores，DI code C317) Duolingo English Test (115 or above) Cambridge International Advanced LEVEL English course--A Cambridge Main Suite Examinations(FCE≥169 or CAE≥180 or CPE） Note: For the list of English-speaking countries, please refer to the official website of NPU International College, download here .
